name: Canaria-Phase3C-nested-cv-regression-teacher-selection-v1
motivation: Phase3B single-validation-split Stage A selected short_25, but fresh Stage B did not establish a materially stronger held-out teacher even though composition-budget and selected-utility gates passed.
architecture: unchanged Phase3 residual MLP: input->Linear64+GELU->4 residual blocks->Linear1

outer_split.outer_test_policy: indices are fixed before outcomes; labels/predictions are never evaluated during this Stage C teacher selection

inner_cv.normalization: each fold fits feature mean/std and target mean/std on that fold's training portion only; its validation fold is transformed with those training-only statistics
inner_cv.inferential_boundary: 15 validation R2 values per recipe are calibration evidence only; they do not constitute independent external datasets

numeric_profile.adamw_sqrt_intervention: float32 Tensor.sqrt calls only inside AdamW.step are evaluated in float64 and cast back to float32
numeric_profile.boundary: same separately validated R87 research profile; not a universal backend guarantee

selection_rule.eligible: recipe aggregate mean of all 15 CV R2 values >= 0.35 AND improvement over baseline aggregate mean >= 0.10
selection_rule.winner: among eligible recipes, maximize the minimum of the five fold-level means (each fold mean averages the three initialization seeds); ties within 1e-12: higher aggregate mean, then lower standard deviation across 15 values, then earlier fixed recipe order
selection_rule.rationale: uses only training-pool resampling and explicitly favors fold-stable performance after Phase3B exposed single-split selection variance
selection_rule.if_none: STOP_NO_STABLE_SAME_ARCHITECTURE_TEACHER; do not inspect outer test or change architecture/recipe grid

diagnostics: aggregate mean/std validation R2 per recipe
five fold-level seed-averaged R2 values and their minimum
paired improvement over baseline using matching fold and initialization seed
leave-one-fold-out winner identity as descriptive stability only; it does not alter the locked winner rule
C: A multi-fold selector may still fail to find a recipe materially better than baseline within this architecture.
Cross-validation stability inside one small dataset may not translate to a new outer test split.
The Phase3B composition result may be robust even if no materially stronger teacher can be established on this dataset.
U: This is teacher-selection calibration, not confirmatory evidence for compositional simplification.
The diabetes dataset has only 442 observations; fold estimates remain noisy and correlated through shared data.
No Phase3B test outcome is used to choose among recipes or folds.
stopping_rule: Evaluate exactly the fixed 13 recipes x 5 folds x 3 initialization seeds. Persist all 195 rows. Apply the locked rule once. No recipe/fold/seed additions after outcomes. Outer test remains unused regardless of selection result.
